newsitem.title: UK: Dated Brent firms to trade at July Brent -20 cents.
newsitem.headline: Dated Brent firms to trade at July Brent -20 cents.

text.p: Dated Brent firmed on Monday as a U.S. refiner picked up an early June cargo for a narrower discount to July Brent paper, traders said.
The cargo, one of Monday's three June 3-5 dates, was kept by Wall Street trader Aron and then sold on for July Brent -20 cents.
A May 28-30 cargo fetched July Brent -29 cents on Friday.
Other sellers still holding late May cargoes were also hoping to improve on Friday's level, encouraged by a robust arbitrage to the U.S.
